text:
Elena Park: Quick heads-up 10 — Hydra Labs enablement next Wed. CEO requested a short exec-friendly demo first 15m for the renewal check-in. Need to reshuffle the 90m workshop into two parts.
Marco Ruiz: got it. We can split: 15m exec demo + 60m hands-on lab later the same day. Tess, Ravi, you good to run hands-on?
Tess Nguyen: I can run the hands-on at 3pm PT, but need someone to cover the migration checklist segment.
Ravi Kapoor: I9m free after 2:30pm PT. Happy to take migration checklist + live troubleshooting (30m).
Elena Park: Proposed schedule:
```
2:45-3:00pm PT  Exec demo & success metrics (Elena + Marco)
3:00-3:30pm PT  Migration checklist + migration owner Q&A (Ravi)
3:30-4:30pm PT  Hands-on lab + support rotation (Tess)
4:30-4:45pm PT  Wrap, feedback capture, next steps (All)
```
Marco Ruiz: That runtime gives Hydra their exec signal before the detailed lab. Works with my calendar. I'll shorten my demo to 10m and keep 5m for immediate asks.
Tess Nguyen: FYI Hydra asked for a dedicated runbook snippet for their air-gapped setup. Do we have that ready?
Ravi Kapoor: We have a draft; I9ll finalize and drop it in the invite. Will also attach the prioritized migration issues list (they have 7 outstanding items; renewal team flagged 3 as blockers).
Elena Park: Important: renewal touchpoint is in 3 weeks. Please put action items into the post-session template so Renewals can pick up unresolved blockers.
Marco Ruiz: Will add a "renewal risk" section in the meeting notes with owner tags.
OnboardingBot: Hydra Labs  enablement updated by Marco Ruiz. 48 RSVPs. Recording enabled.
Tess Nguyen: I'll prepare the lab VM snapshot and a condensed troubleshooting FAQ. Will post link 24h ahead.
Ravi Kapoor: Can someone own the feedback capture? I can collect raw notes but need someone to synthesize into the CSAT/renewal tracker.
Elena Park: Marco, can you synthesize and add to the renewal tracker?
Marco Ruiz: Yep. I9ll synthesize and tag owners in the tracker by EOD after the session.
Elena Park: Final checklist before I update the calendar invite: 1) Marco adds pre-read and renewal-risk section, 2) Ravi finalizes runbook + blockers list, 3) Tess posts lab snapshot + FAQ, 4) Marco will synthesize feedback. If all good I9ll move the event start to 2:45pm PT.
Tess Nguyen: good to me.
Ravi Kapoor: good.
OnboardingBot: Reminder set: Hydra Labs enablement 24h and 1h prior.
Elena Park: thanks everyone  please react :white_check_mark: when you9re done updating your items and I9ll publish the new agenda.
